title: Millionaire for Life Number Watch — Number 21 Has Gone Quiet for 40 Draws
headline: Number 21 Has Gone Quiet for 40 Draws

prose.intro: Our tracker flagged something in the latest Millionaire for Life draw: number 21 has now sat out 40 drawings in a row — the longest absence anywhere in our 50-draw window.
prose.fact: The previous record in this window was a 33-draw absence. Number 21 is at 40 and still counting.
prose.context: The usual reminder applies, and it matters most on days like this: draws are independent. A streak, a gap or an odd shape says nothing about what the next drawing will do. We log these because they describe the data, not because they change it.
